title: Launch ecosystem deployment canvas and minute logbook
content:
Purpose
This is a compact, minute-by-minute focused canvas for the upcoming 5-day deployment window. Primary goals: keep latency SLOs, avoid disruption to Dedicated customers, validate fallback routing, and capture release notes as we go. Working doc — expect edits during dry run and preflight.

Context & scope
- Release bundle: runtime v2.8.1 + routing policy v1.4 + metrics export shim.
- Core risk areas: canary KV cache mismatch, cross-region routing mis-sync, autoscaler overshoot during warm-up.
- Primary services touched: model-router, serve-agent, kv-cache, metrics-proxy.

High-level rollout approach (summary)
- Day -2: dry run in staging with recorded traffic replay (simulate peak). Verify smoke gates.
- Day -1: limited canary (5% traffic) in eu-west and us-east with consistent load tests.
- Day 0: rolling push to remaining regions, 10% increments per region with 15m observation window.
- Day +1..+2: capacity ramp and throttling curve adjustments, monitor tail-latency.
- Day +3: finalize rollout, update docs, publish release notes.

Week calendar (minute-logbook style)
- Day -2 (2026-05-10) staging dry-run
  - 09:00 - kickoff, owners + slack channel pinned
  - 09:15 - start replay: 60m baseline then 30m spike test (1.5x peak)
  - 10:45 - quick triage, patch replay if KV mismatch observed
  - 13:00 - record perf traces, export to perf-bench bucket
  - Notes: record exact traffic seed for Day -1 replay replication

- Day -1 (2026-05-11) limited canary
  - 07:00 - morning checkpoint: config snapshot, feature toggles verified
  - 08:00 - deploy canary in eu-west (5%) + us-east (5%)
  - 08:15 - smoke test: health-checks, top-endpoint latency < 95th pct baseline + 30ms
  - 09:00 - start 1h soak with production synthetic users, check error rate and 99th pct
  - 10:15 - decision gate: continue to 10% or rollback (see gating thresholds)

- Day 0 (2026-05-12) rolling regional push
  - 06:00 - preflight checklist (see below)
  - 07:00 - begin region roll (us-west -> us-east-2 -> eu-central -> ap-south). Stagger start times by 30m
  - For each region:
    - t+0: deploy control plane + model-router config
    - t+5m: deploy serve-agent instances (canary subset first)
    - t+15m: run smoke suite (synthetic path + end-to-end chat flows)
    - t+30m: open traffic to 10% -> monitor 15m
    - t+45m: if stable, increase to 30% -> monitor 20m
    - t+90m: increase to 100% (or hold and consult)
  - 18:00 - end-of-day roll summary, publish interim notes to #deploy-week-ops-threads

- Day +1 (2026-05-13) ramp and tune
  - Autoscaler tuning window 08:00-12:00: adjust burst thresholds, max instance perms
  - Cache warm-up sweep: trigger prefix-heavy synthetic runs to pre-fill KV caches
  - Perf regression sweep: run A/B traces comparing v2.7.5 baseline to v2.8.1

- Day +2 (2026-05-14) finalize
  - Documentation update: console dashboard entries, rollout flags in config store
  - Release notes: draft, review, legal/comms sign-off
  - Retrospective: quick look at anomalies and action items

Preflight checklist (must pass before any region push)
- [ ] Config snapshots saved (S3: deploy-snapshots/2026-05-12) and hash recorded
- [ ] Validated canary image SHA and model artifact checksums
- [ ] Circuit-breakers in place on route switch (default TTLs restored)
- [ ] Observability: traces enabled for model-router and kv-cache; perf dashboards synched
- [ ] RBAC and KMS policies verified for Private deployments (customer-specific)
- [ ] Pager rota confirmed and escalation matrix visible in #oncall

Hour-of deploy checklist (quick)
- Confirm: oncall + release lead responded in channel
- Confirm: database migrations (if any) applied in preflight mode
- Start traffic ramp as per region schedule
- Watch: 5m, 15m, 30m, 60m post-change windows for error spikes
- If any gate fails: immediate rollback to previous stable image and open rollback incident ticket

Gating thresholds (decision criteria)
- Error rate: sustained > 0.5% for 5m -> fail gate
- 99th latency: > baseline + 50ms for two consecutive windows (15m each) -> hold/rollback review
- P50/P90 drift alone is acceptable up to +20ms, but must be correlated with lower error counts
- Memory/cpu host saturation: > 85% for more than 10m -> hold and scale back traffic

Rollback matrix (fast reference)
- Symptom: sudden >1% error rate across endpoints -> rollback region to previous control-plane image, pause routing changes
- Symptom: KV cache mismatch (inconsistent predictions) -> rollback model-router and invalidate caches, apply hotfix at PR #2987 if available
- Symptom: Autoscaler thrash -> revert autoscaler policy and pin instance counts per region until stability confirmed

Observability & telemetry notes
- Dashboards to watch: release-rollup (overview), model-router-latency, kv-cache-hitrate, cost-per-token (for Hosted API), error-trace-top20
- Important traces: first-request-of-session path, prefix-cache-warm path, degrade-to-fallback path. Tag traces with release:v2.8.1
- Sampling change: increase trace sampling from 1% -> 10% for first 6 hours in canary regions only

Release notes draft (living)
- Title: runtime v2.8.1 — smarter routing + KV stability fixes
- Highlights:
  - Improved routing for cross-region fallbacks to reduce cold-starts (up to 15% latency improvement in common paths)
  - Fix: KV cache invalidation race fixed (INF-4123) — reduces inconsistent completions during canary rollouts
  - Telemetry: additional token-level cost breakdowns emitted for hosted API customers (beta)
- Breaking changes: none expected; customers on Dedicated may need to refresh KMS keys if using rotated keys older than 90d (note and link to KB)
- Known issues: temporary spike in telemetry ingestion during initial ramp — metric smoothing rule applied

Communications schedule
- Live updates during roll: post short status notes every region completion + any decision gates triggered
- Internal postmortem window: start within 24h of finalizing rollout, post to Confluence and circulate to eng + product reps
- Customer comms: targeted blow-by-blow only if rollback or visible disruption occurs. Otherwise weekly release digest with summary and impact notes

Open TODOs (notes to self)
- Confirm legal sign-off on token-level cost beta wording (Aisha)
- Add a small synthetic test to exercise fallback model variant chains (Omar)
- Get approval to keep trace sampling elevated for 8 hours if we observe subtle regressions
- Add a short script to auto-collect instance snapshots into a single artifact for postmortem

Quick end-of-day reporter template (for ops post in channel)
- What we changed: (region, components)
- Observed: (errors, latency, autoscale behavior)
- Actions taken: (rollback? throttle? patch applied?)
- Next steps: (tuning / follow-up owners)

Retrospective prompts (for post-release)
- Did throttling curve achieve expected cost/latency tradeoff?
- Any signal we missed? (missing traces, insufficient sampling)
- Who was blocked? Any runbook gaps?
- Quick wins to reduce blast radius next time

Appendix
- Key tickets: INF-4123 (kv race), INF-4190 (routing fallbacks), ENGOPS-221 (autoscaler tweaks)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2987 (model-router patch)
- Slack threads: #deploy-week-ops-threads (pinned), #oncall (escalation)

---
Notes: keep this doc minimal and update live. Prefer short bullet updates in the channel over long doc edits during the window. Save final release notes here and copy to product-release for customer-facing changes.
